sections.heading: D  st-b: drift after PREPARED → rollback to the original location
lines: ++ append to source b.txt → promote: source_drift → INVALIDATED; target marker still the source marker; mount FENCED rev1

name: 03-after-promotion-settings
title: After promotion: wrong deployment settings fail closed — and recover by fixing the setting
subtitle: Same migrated st-a (S2) restarted four times; Turn = cold load + WRITE probe.txt; S3 repeats the QWEN_HOME arm with an unmigrated storage alongside

sections.heading: Restart arms on the migrated storage
table: QWEN_HOME = symlink → the same canonical home

sections.heading: QWEN_HOME gate applies only to migrated storages (S3)
Operator error during maintenance: Spring started while the storage fence is installed (S2 B0)
lines: ++ st-a cold load → 503 managed_session_open_failed; 0 st-a workers started; no file written
++ st-b (other storage, same tenant) → Turn completes
!! server.log: 0 lines naming QWEN_HOME, history or the mount for any of the refusals above

note: R1-2 data: the refusal is not permanent — restoring the canonical QWEN_HOME and the new mapping restores service immediately. A symlinked QWEN_HOME is refused before promotion by the worker, so it cannot reach COMPLETED through the runbook.
